experiment: Experiment 34 — SeRCA Semantic-guided Relational Complementary Alignment

paper_audit.actual_code: GFR is four between-subject graphs; GraphLearn returns raw thresholded cosine; GFR applies normalize_adj(A+I), propagates full 320D concatenated features and preserves i=1 overwrite; PLN is InputLayer->Encoder->FeedForward->PEN/OutputLayer; current simple-2 optimizes ClsLoss plus four raw-adjacency GraphConstructLoss mean and does not optimize ALoss.
paper_audit.paper_code_difference: Paper Eq.(1) includes a label graph loss absent from optimized local simple-2; paper Eq.(2) describes multi-relation fusion but local GFR i=1 assignment overwrites i=0; local shell hyperparameters differ from paper ABIDE table. Current checkout and Experiment32 protocol govern reproduction.
paper_audit.baseline_p0: Construct original PLN in original order including inactive PEN MLP, cached CLIP prompt buffer and AvgPool; bypass only PEN forward. CAM output is [N,4,36] mixed latent positions; four 9D blocks are not ROIs.
paper_audit.ablation_paper: Figure 2 reports baseline/GFR/RES/full PEN; largest claimed gain is GFR. Ablation does not isolate semantic text necessity.
paper_audit.author_vs_current: The five current checkout core source hashes above match origin/main. Upstream author network.py and utils.py have distinct SHA-256 from the current repository; all training uses the locally audited Experiment32 current checkout, not reconstructed author code.

related_work.MMGPL: GPT-4 concepts weight patches and define a token graph inside neuroimaging; SeRCA does not claim concept weighting or semantic graphs as novel.
related_work.MGDR: Per-modality patient graphs plus shared/private disentanglement and contrastive learning; supports complementarity as a known goal.
related_work.KDBrain: Semantic-conditioned attention queries plus pathology-consistent KL over subnetworks; disease-guided interactions and clinical priors are prior art.
related_work.InfoBridge: Conditional MI with protective margin for sharing and preserving modality-specific detail; different objective and domain.
related_work.ToAlign: Directly tests that forced representation alignment can help or hurt depending on task; motivates aligning messages without forcing modality feature equality.

method.location: after PLN InputLayer and before Encoder
method.raw_graph_source: same GFR forward raw GraphLearn matrices; no second GraphLearn call
method.base_graph: B_m=repository.normalize_adj(A_m+I), reused from the same GFR forward
method.residual: Delta_t=0.10*tanh(alpha_t)*R_t; per-patient token L2 cap=0.10*||H_i,t||2; alpha starts at zero
method.branch_parameters: alpha[4], theta[4,4,4]; Adam PLN group, lr=0.0038, weight_decay=0; S6 freezes theta and uses exact uniform weights
method.original_graph_loss: unchanged GraphConstructLoss on the four original raw A_m matrices

worker_protocol: S0 runs first as one continuous 10-fold seed0 worker and snapshots full Python/NumPy/torch CPU/CUDA RNG before each construction. Each S1-S9 worker runs its own 10 folds, restoring the paired S0 fold-entry RNG; it does not claim natural cross-fold RNG continuity.

decision.interpretation: The frozen method was evaluated as registered. The results do not satisfy every internal criterion required to claim that correct medical concepts guide cross-modal complementary relations.
